name: animated-grid-pattern
title: Animated Grid Pattern
description: An animated background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the SVG. Grid lines use `stroke-*`/`fill-*`, lit squares use the text colour.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of one grid cell in pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of one grid cell in pixels.

props.name: x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the pattern in pixels.

props.name: y
props.description: Vertical offset of the pattern in pixels.

props.name: strokeDasharray
props.description: SVG stroke-dasharray of the grid lines.

props.name: numSquares
props.description: Number of squares lit up at any time.

props.name: maxOpacity
props.description: Opacity a square fades up to.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds a square takes to fade in (and again to fade out).

props.name: repeatDelay
props.description: Seconds a square stays lit before fading out.
